74.title: Obsidian Setup
74.content: This is a document to setup my Obsidian Vault, with all the structures, plugins, theme and others

75.title: Obsidian Setup
75.content:
## Structure
the vault would have the following folders:
- Files: PDF and other files
- Images: images that are used in the notes
- Notes: all markdown notes
- Templates: used to store the templates we will be using

76.title: Obsidian Setup
76.content:
## Plugins
these are the plugins used in the setup
### Git
this is used to setup for backup of the notes

make sure to include this `.gitignore` file in the vault so it only backup the notes and files

- commit message: {replace_me_with_device_name} vault backup: {{date}}
- pull on startup: on

### Paste URL into selection
Insert links (URLs) into a selected text "notion-style" using regular `Ctrl/Cmd + V`

### Excalidraw
this is helpful when drawing things 

### Calendar
to have a pretty calendar in the view

### WOAKI
this is the plugin I made for memorizing notes and having a RAG system for it to ask questions about notes
